item.title: Version 2.3.2
item.description:
What's new in HockeyNow 2.3.2

  • Picks & Fantasy tab: watch-party countdowns, pick'em with a running record, and pinned fantasy players.
  • Siri & Shortcuts: next game, score and standings.
  • Shot map and expected goals (xG) for every game.
  • Per-team alert profiles, plus trade and injury alerts.
  • Notch live pop-outs on goals, penalties and period ends, and exact on-ice strength (e.g. 5 on 4).
  • Three stars, play-by-play and a post-game tab.
  • Standings now use the official NHL tiebreakers (with ROW).
  • Settings, picks and alert profiles are backed up so they survive updates.
